Meet the game

Your next discovery is on the map.

Knowing a country’s name is one thing. Finding it on a map is another. MapBop turns short map challenges into a daily habit of discovery. Meet, try, and revisit as the world becomes more familiar.

In-game screenshot

Tap. learn. explore.

Even a wrong guess
can take you somewhere.

Place your answer on the map and see how close you came. Location feedback and short fact cards turn each attempt into a chance to learn something new.

  • Answer directly on the map
  • See the distance from your guess to the target
  • Get to know countries and capitals
In-game screenshot

Make exploring a habit

Go around the world.
Fill your passport.

Return for your daily route, revisit familiar places, and collect stamps as you explore regions. When you feel like a little competition, race a friend on the same phone.

  • Daily review and Daily Route
  • Streaks and passport stamps
  • A same-device race with a friend

Your first move

Three steps into the game.

MapBop
  1. 01

    Meet a region.

    Discover new countries and capitals. Meet their locations on the map before putting your knowledge to the test.

  2. 02

    Tap your answer.

    Find the answer on the map. Earn stars through easy, medium, hard, and boss challenges.

  3. 03

    Keep your route going.

    Keep places fresh with daily reviews. Finish a new route and make room for discoveries in your passport.

A little help

A question before you play?

Game support
Are WhereIsIt and MapBop the same game?

Yes. WhereIsIt is the project name. The current game and store brand is MapBop: Geography Game. This page covers both names.

Do I need an account?

No. Your progress, settings, and race history stay on your device, as do the player names entered for a race.

When will it be in stores?

A release date has not been announced. App Store and Google Play links will appear here when ready.
